clauses.clause: Mega pursues without LOS and takes longer routes around tight alleys, fence gaps, culverts and doorways; staying still draws it in. A red pulsing minimap dot shows its real position while near, with footsteps/roars between sightings.
clauses.note: High seed1 tick 49647→49648: same Mega id 115 moved (2978.093,-4.771)→(3337.350,95.000), 372.853 m in one tick, player alive and no restore event. Low tick 44738→44739: same id moved (3136.142,61.850)→(3337.346,94.995), 203.916 m, player alive and no restore event. LevelTenStory stages the existing Mega beside the player for l10-overpass-mega, directly assigning its x/z. This breaks continuous pursuit around terrain. Other large displacements coincide with checkpoint restoration and are not counted as pursuit failures. Native complete-input runs; separate mortal physical playtest documented in lane report did not reach this point. Minimap and audio portions remain unreviewed.

evidence.what: Both-tier native complete-route per-tick Mega displacement and checkpoint event audit.
Overpass staging directly assigns the pursuing Mega position near the courier.

notes: Definitive pursuit discontinuity counterexample; failure does not imply completion of other row checks.
